title: Parties in Stockholm and England, the Prince of Wales
summary: He recalls a Stockholm party, little of England, and thinks the Prince of Wales played drums with the band.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Irving Mills told me that when you went to England that there was a reception or a party with and the King of England was there, and the whole band was there?
What do you remember about that party?

We had a party in Stockholm, I think it was -- in Stockholm we had a party with a lot of big, up-to-date people and it was a big place, and we had dancing, with all the band playing over there, entertaining the boys in the band, and Duke, and we had a wonderful time. But in England, I don't remember; I know we went someplace, but I can't remember what it was. I know it was the Lord (unintelligible)
Wasn't there -- didn't the King of England sit in with the band or something -- or he played for the band or something like that I think Irving Mills mentioned.
I think the fellow -- what's his name,
Yeah. The Prince of Wales was the one who used to play drums, you know?
Uh huh. Did he sit in with the band? at the party?
Well, I can't remember. Honestly, I don't remember, but I believe something happened like that, but I don't know where or when.
That was probably the first time you had royalty at a party with the band?
